notes: IC1 identifies adult (>=18) metastatic breast cancer patients via an INNER JOIN of Demographics and Extracted_BreastDiagnosis with a computed Age_At_Diagnosis. The external L0 libname (Flatiron EHR) is not in the repo, so autoexec seeds small WORK stand-ins with the same columns/types and the script reads WORK.* instead of L0.*; the join, metastatic filter, and age expression are unchanged. Added a trailing PROC PRINT to show the resulting cohort.
